abstract: We evaluated the feasibility, morbidity, and efficacy of laparoscopic management of ovarian cysts and the concordant sonographic appearance with histologic diagnosis. Preoperative assessments included a detailed family history, pelvic and general examinations, and transvaginal ultrasound examination. The last revealed simple cysts in 38 (69.1%), septate cysts in 15 (27.3%), and complex cysts in 2 (3.6%) women. The final diagnosis was made by peritoneal fluid cytology and intraoperative histologic diagnosis. Of the cysts diagnosed as functional, eight were simple cysts. In the serous group, 17 were simple and 6 septate. In the teratoma group, six were simple, five were septate, and two were complex cysts. The two thought to be paraovarian were only simple cysts. All ultrasound evaluations agreed with the benign histologic diagnoses. We performed 28 enucleations, 10 cystectomies, and 17 ovariectomies. There were no postoperative complications. Laparoscopy seems to be the best choice of surgery for benign ovarian cysts, the results of transvaginal ultrasound examinations being fully concordant with the histologic diagnoses.
abstract_ja: 卵巣嚢胞に対する腹腔鏡下治療の実行可能性、合併症、有効性、および経膣超音波検査所見と組織学的診断との一致性を評価した。術前評価には詳細な家族歴、骨盤および全身診察、経膣超音波検査を含めた。経膣超音波検査では、単純性嚢胞38例(69.1%)、隔壁性嚢胞15例(27.3%)、複雑性嚢胞2例(3.6%)が認められた。最終診断は腹水細胞診と術中組織診断により確定した。機能性と診断された嚢胞のうち8例は単純性嚢胞であった。漿液性群では17例が単純性、6例が隔壁性であった。奇形腫群では6例が単純性、5例が隔壁性、2例が複雑性嚢胞であった。傍卵巣嚢胞と考えられた2例はいずれも単純性嚢胞であった。超音波所見はすべて良性の組織学的診断と一致した。核出術28例、嚢胞摘出術10例、卵巣摘出術17例を施行した。術後合併症は認められなかった。良性卵巣嚢胞に対しては腹腔鏡手術が最適な手術法であり、経膣超音波検査所見は組織学的診断と完全に一致した。
